claim_ceiling: Candidate request only; no Lab type admission, implementation choice, participant collection or release.

compatibility_analysis.rejection_reason: The generic Contract carrier preserves obligation references but not closed test stimulus, environment and acceptance checks for one integration boundary.
Challenge Contract governs contesting subjects, challengers and resolution; it is not a technical spike or acceptance test contract.
Experiment Design is for a research study; the immediate synthetic engineering spike does not itself recruit participants or test a scientific claim.

expiry.condition: Resolved, rejected or superseded by exact Artifact Type owner review.

validation_purpose: Specify one integration option review’s executable checks, acceptance gates, failure route and evidence needed before selection.
